[[Category:Operating Systems]]

What is a monitor?  
A silent sentinel of code,  
Guarding the threads  
From racing shadows  
And tangled fates.  

Other stuff drifts by,  
Confusion like mist,  
Yet the monitor endures—  
A watcher, a keeper,  
An unseen hand of order.  

== What is a monitor ==  
The monitor is the quiet eye  
That sees the flow,  
That steadies the stream,  
Ensuring each voice of the program  
Speaks in its turn.
